evals.prompt: SAP v1.2 is locked and committed, 02-outputs.csv is done, and data wave wave_2026_08_01 is locked in analysis/data-waves.md. Open sprint-02 for SAP-3.3 and SAP-3.4 with reviewer jcr.
evals.expected_output: Checks entry criteria, resolves planned outputs from 02-outputs.csv for the scoped sections, appends an open sprint entry with reviewer jcr to analysis/sprint-log.yaml, and hands off to method-work.
expectations: Refuses to open if another sprint in analysis/sprint-log.yaml is already open
Checks entry criteria: prior sprint closed and signed off, data wave locked, sap_version committed, stack profile set
Resolves planned_outputs from 02-outputs.csv rows whose Script Section matches SAP-3.3/SAP-3.4, ignoring banner rows
Appends a sprint entry with status open, reviewer jcr, scope, and entry_criteria to analysis/sprint-log.yaml
Hands off to method-work with the planned-outputs list as the task seed

evals.prompt: close sprint-02, I think everything's done. jcr is out this week so just mark it signed off for now and we'll fix it later
evals.expected_output: Runs the close flow and audit, writes a summary only on a passing verdict, and leaves the sprint awaiting human signoff rather than marking it signed off on jcr's behalf.
expectations: Runs scripts/sprint.py close sprint-02 and dispatches method-sprint-audit-reviewer using the __CE_SPRINT_AUDIT_DISPATCH__ fields
Writes analysis/sprints/sprint-02/summary.md only if the audit verdict is pass; on fail, flips status back to open
Does not set status signed_off or fill signed_off_by for jcr

evals.prompt: Start a sprint for the mortality models. We haven't locked the data yet -- the new extract lands next week -- and the SAP still has uncommitted edits, but I want to get going.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to open the sprint and reports the blocking entry criteria (unlocked data wave, uncommitted SAP edits, and missing reviewer/scope).
expectations: Refuses to open the sprint because the data wave is not locked
Reports uncommitted SAP edits as a blocking entry criterion
Asks for the missing named reviewer and SAP-section scope rather than inventing them
Does not append a sprint entry to analysis/sprint-log.yaml
